data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (reach Bridges & Tunnels, open tolls by vehicle, pick the vehicle type) and names vehicle type as a parameter, but it misses the facility parameter, leaves the entry point vague ("Fares & Tolls / Bridges and Tunnels" instead of Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels), and never says to view the rate, so an automation would need guesswork.
